entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
Choosing where to study is a big decision. For these Indian students, it came down to finding a place where learning leads somewhere real.
In this video, AUT students share why they chose to study in New Zealand – and why AUT felt like the right fit. From hands-on learning and industry-connected study to feeling supported, included and confident about what comes next.
They talk about: 
• Finding real opportunities and connections in a genuinely multicultural university
• Employability support that helps you graduate work ready, not just qualified 
• Life in Auckland – where the city, beaches and green spaces are part of everyday life
If you’re thinking about studying overseas and want an education that works beyond the classroom, this is where that journey can start.
👉 Explore your study options at AUT:
https://www.aut.ac.nz/international/india
#AUT #AucklandUniversity #NewZealand #InternationalStudents #StudyAbroad
